edges.reason: Constructor reads msg.sender to assign the initial totalSupply balance.
constructor uses totalSupply to mint the deployer balance.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] with the totalSupply value.
balanceOf indexes balances with the owner parameter.
balanceOf reads the balances state variable.
transfer reads balances of msg.sender as the source of funds.
transfer recipient parameter flows into balance updates.
transfer value parameter flows into balance updates.
transfer performs balances[to] += value arithmetic on user-controlled amount.
transfer performs balances[msg.sender] -= value arithmetic on user-controlled amount.
value parameter is added to the recipient balance.
value parameter is subtracted from the sender balance.
Arithmetic addition writes into the balances mapping.
Arithmetic subtraction writes into the balances mapping.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender identity for the allowance check.
from parameter selects the source balance and allowance entry in transferFrom.
to parameter selects the destination balance in transferFrom.
value parameter drives the transfer amount in transferFrom.
transferFrom requires the allowance check before moving funds.
transferFrom reads the allowance mapping for authorization.
allowance check consumes allowance[from][msg.sender] state.
transferFrom performs balances[to] += value arithmetic.
transferFrom performs balances[from] -= value arithmetic.
value parameter is added to the recipient balance in transferFrom.
value parameter is subtracted from the source balance in transferFrom.
Arithmetic addition writes into the balances mapping in transferFrom.
Arithmetic subtraction writes into the balances mapping in transferFrom.
approve writes allowance for msg.sender as the owner granting approval.
spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
value parameter is stored as the approved allowance in approve.
approve writes the allowance state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The owner parameter is only used as the lookup key inside balanceOf, so it folds into that core function.
The to parameter is only consumed by the transfer function's balance update.
The value parameter is only consumed by the transfer function's arithmetic balance updates.
The from parameter is only consumed by the transferFrom allowance check and balance update.
The to parameter is only consumed by the transferFrom destination balance update.
The value parameter is only consumed by the transferFrom arithmetic balance updates.
The spender parameter is only used as the allowance mapping key inside approve.
The value parameter is only used as the stored allowance value inside approve.
